incident.title: Website name cannot be resolved
incident.description: Our browser says the website cannot be found. This started around 10:00 UTC after we edited DNS records in the domain panel. We do not remember exactly which records changed. We cannot tell whether the web server is still working.

context.reported_change: Customer reports DNS edits shortly before the failure; exact edits not available.
